user.title: Set up PHIL9000
user.description: Pick the entity types PHIL9000 should learn from. It only watches at first — nothing is ever acted on until you confirm a learned behaviour. You can add or exclude individual devices later in the integration's options.

error.no_entities: Pick at least one entity type to observe.

init.title: PHIL9000 settings
init.description: Settings for what PHIL9000 observes, plus pattern analysis and suggestions.

data.exclude_entities: Never observe these entities (even within observed types)

data.analysis_enabled: Run nightly pattern analysis (optional, off by default)
